title: This Queen Lays an Egg Every 3 Seconds and Can Live 60 Years

scenes.text: One insect lays 30,000 eggs a day. For decades.
The queen of the African termite Macrotermes bellicosus. She can grow 14 centimetres long. Her king is one or two.
Her abdomen swells into an egg factory. Britannica puts her output at up to 36,000 eggs a day, roughly one every three seconds.
Her workers and soldiers live two to five years each.
The queen and king of the higher termites can live 60 to 70 years.
Tens of thousands a day, for decades. One mother, hundreds of millions of children.

description:
Queens of the African termite Macrotermes bellicosus can reach 14 centimetres long and lay up to 30,000 eggs a day, according to Guinness World Records; Britannica gives up to 36,000 a day.
Workers and soldiers live two to five years, but the primary king and queen of the higher termites may live 60 to 70 years.
How many children would that add up to?
subject: termite queen
first_comment: Thirty thousand eggs a day for sixty years is over 650 million. Which animal mother should we cover next?
